standard: FEMA Historical Geospatial Damage Assessment Database (GDA)
notes: FEMA GDA uses exact field names from the ArcGIS FeatureServer schema (fetched live). DMG_LEVEL coded values: NOD/AFF/MIN/MAJ/DES/UNK. ASMT_TYPE: RS=fire-crew windshield survey, AI=automated classification of aerial imagery (the time is when the classification was produced), FV=joint field verification, HI=FEMA housing inspection. Each row is one structure or infrastructure segment assessed.

entity_catalog.assets: 06_data_streams/infrastructure_assets.json assets[] (asset_id; substations, water plant and pumps, tanks, wastewater plants, bridges, airport, fuel terminal)

fields.name: structure_id
fields.notes: CC-<n>; one structure can have several assessment rows

fields.name: LATITUDE
fields.notes: WGS84, on land beside the named street

fields.name: DMG_LEVEL
fields.notes: DST destroyed, MAJ major, MIN minor, AFF affected, NVD no visible damage

fields.name: ASMT_TYPE
fields.notes: RS fire-crew windshield survey, AI automated classification of aerial imagery, FV joint field verification, HI FEMA housing inspection

fields.name: ASMT_DATE
fields.notes: Local date and time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM

fields.name: FOUNDATION
fields.notes: Slab (first floor about 0.5 ft above grade), Pier and beam (about 2.5 ft), Elevated (on pilings, about 9 ft)

fields.name: FLOOD_DEPTH_FT
fields.notes: High-water mark above grade at the structure, measured on site; filled on field verification (FV) and housing inspection (HI) rows, empty where nobody measured (AI, RS)

fields.name: ROOF_DAMAGE_PCT
fields.notes: Share of roof covering lost; on AI rows the classifier's estimate from imagery, on FV and HI rows the inspector's; empty on windshield surveys (RS)

joins.to: for registered infrastructure: infrastructure_assets.json asset_id or facility_registry.json facility_id; individual homes and businesses get their own structure ids

location_rule: LATITUDE/LONGITUDE must be on land (scripts/check_geo.py rule 'land_fixed'); structures belong on street frontages.
generator_reference: What the data must show, and when, is in 00_scenario/canon_timeline.json (internal). This schema describes format and joins only. Generators: scripts/streams/gen_ground.py and gen_ground_public.py; checks: scripts/check_streams.py, scripts/check_geo.py.

files.05_other_sources/infrastructure/damage_a: structure damage assessments, one row per assessment
files.05_other_sources/infrastructure/utility_: aerial survey findings per utility site (asset_id from infrastructure_assets.json): columns asset_id, asset_name, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, survey_time_utc, phase, sensor, tile_set_id, tiles, yard_flood_status, visible_condition, equipment_observation. survey_time_utc is the start of the site's image acquisition; tile_set_id joins drone_video/logs/flight_log.csv or the collection index
files.05_other_sources/infrastructure/aerial_s: aerial collections with tile counts and coverage: columns collection_id, start_utc, end_utc, phase, sensor, tiles, coverage, targets
